誰在
廁所裡？
文／珍妮．威利斯　圖／阿德蘭．雷諾
譯／林盈惠

[P2] 文 珍妮·威利斯 Jeanne Willis
從會拿筆的那一天起，珍妮就開始了她的創作之路。二十一歲時她出版了第一本書，至今已有八十多本作品，不論是圖畫書或青少年小說，都得到許多獎項的肯定，也廣受各國小讀者的歡迎。她曾從事廣告傳播業；有十幾個小孩、電影廣告作品。現在是全職的作家及編劇，和家人一起住在英國倫敦北部，養了兩個小孩、幾隻貓和幾隻老鼠。興趣是園藝、讀書、蒐集毛毛蟲。已出版的中文版圖畫書作品包括《壞壞》、《不快樂的母牛》、《上學真討厭》、《不要放了喔！》以及《喔，大家安靜！》等。
■ 阿德南·雷諾斯 Adrian Reynolds
出生於英國威爾斯南部，從斯溫席藝術學院（Swansea College of Art）和劍橋郡藝術與工藝學院（Cambridgeshire College of Art and Technology）畢業之後，阿德南就到一家兒童書店工作，並且開始了自己的圖畫書創作。自從第一本畫於一九九七年出版以來，他已累積了二十多本作品，其中包括Pete and Polo 系列的四本書以及與伊恩·威柏（Ian Whybrow）合作出版的一系列以Harry and the Bucketful of Dinosaurs 為名的暢銷童書，這一系列作品在二○○五年由加拿大 CCI Entertainment 公司及英國 Collingwood O’Hara 公司共同改編成卡通影集，中文片名為《哈利與小恐龍》。
譯 林盈惠
臺灣大學工商管理學系畢業，家裡養了1.5隻貓，喜歡閱讀、烹飪、為小朋友說故事。譯有《FROG STYLE 白變蛙造型繪本》，本身也是一個常常霸佔廁所、害別人等很久的人。

繪本時間 73 誰在廁所裡？

[P3] 是誰在廁所裡呀？
外面的隊伍越排越長了！

[P4] 是不是大象在「嗯～嗯～」呢？
他们一向要「嗯～」好久。
如果不是大象，你猜会是谁呢？

[P5] 是不是鲸鱼在尿尿？尿出了全世界最大的一泡！
是不是老虎要喷喷？
还是流浪的袋熊要上一跳？
难道，是企鹅的尿结成了一根「尿冰棒」？

[P6] 會不會是犀牛正在製造「香噴噴」的「熱咖哩」呢？
也可能是——烏龜喔！
可不是嗎！他們從來也不著急！
不管是谁，這實在有點兒傷腦筋！

[P7] 也許是一隻倉鼠，
他構不到馬桶座。
也許是一隻猴子，
他正在洗腳。
或者是一條蛇，
他坐在那兒悠閒地吃糖果。

[P8] 說不定是一隻可憐的、滑不溜丟的小鯨魚，
他伸手拿衛生紙，結果掉進了馬桶裡，
像一顆黑色的小皮球一樣，在水裡面跳來跳去。

[P9] 難道是河馬的肥屁股
卡在馬桶上？

難道是乳酪害老鼠
吃壞了肚子？

還是貓咪在
玩小船？

是誰在廁所裡？
他們為什麼這麼慢？
我們都快急死啦，該換我們上啦！

[P10] 是不是鳄鱼在修指甲？
还是一群臭鼬在洗尾巴？
莫非，厕所里来了一批行动缓慢的老蜗牛？

[P11] 說不定是一隻樹獺不小心睡著了？
說不定是一位牧羊人在幫他的羊洗澡？
還是，美洲豹心血來潮，決定幫自己換個花樣？大家快來偷看哪！

[P12] 該不會是鼬鼠正在放臭屁吧？
還是一頭豬在水槽裡
洗小內褲？

或者是一隻小海豚？
你說呢！？
到底誰在廁所裡？

[P13] 是誰在廁所裡？
我們怎麼也猜不著。
除了用力敲門，好像也沒有別的辦法了！

我們聽到裡面傳來一個小小聲，它說：
「是我 在廁所裡啦！
我只在做我媽媽叫我做的事……」

「那要花我很長的時間耶！
你們大家是不會懂的！」

[P14] 原来，是小章鱼
在洗他的八双小手！

[P15] 大家都急得快尿出來啦！
廁所裡的傢伙怎麼還不出來？
到底是誰在廁所裡？
是不是企鵝的屎結成了一根「尿冰棒」？
還是犀牛在製造「香噴噴」的「熱咖哩」？
莫非是鱷魚在修指甲？
還是一群臭鼬忙著洗自己的尾巴？……
在這本書裡，你會看到各種有趣的可能性，
但是，不到最後一頁，
你絕對猜不到真相！
成人對這種重複的趣味，可能很快就感到厭倦，
但小孩子們卻會深深的被書中的某些畫面迷住，例如
犀牛在拉肚子，臭氣瀰漫了整間廁所……
——美國學校圖書館學刊（School Library Journal）

Long'an

Who's in the bathroom?
Text by Jenny Willis, Illustrations by Adrian Reynolds
Translated by Lin Ying-hui

[P2] Text by Jeanne Willis
Since the day she first picked up a pen, Jeanne has been on her creative journey. At twenty-one, she published her first book, and now has over eighty works, including picture books and young adult novels, which have received many awards and are widely loved by children around the world. She once worked in advertising and media; she has worked on several children's films and advertisements. Now she is a full-time writer and screenwriter, living with her family in North London, where she raises two children, several cats, and several mice. Her hobbies include gardening, reading, and collecting caterpillars. Her Chinese picture book publications include "Bad Bad," "The Unhappy Cow," "School Is So Boring," "Don't Let Go!" and "Oh, Everyone Be Quiet!".
■ Adrian Reynolds
Born in southern Wales, UK, Adrian graduated from Swansea College of Art and Cambridgeshire College of Art and Technology. After graduation, he worked at a children's bookstore and began creating his own picture books. Since his first book was published in 1997, he has accumulated over twenty works, including four books in the Pete and Polo series and a series of best-selling children's books titled "Harry and the Bucketful of Dinosaurs" co-created with Ian Whybrow. This series was adapted into an animated series in 2005 by CCI Entertainment in Canada and Collingwood O’Hara in the UK, with the Chinese title "Harry and the Little Dinosaurs".
Translator: Lin Yinghui
Graduated from the Department of Business Administration, National Taiwan University. She has 1.5 cats at home and enjoys reading, cooking, and telling stories to children. She has translated "FROG STYLE: A Frog's造型 Picture Book" and is also someone who often occupies the bathroom, making others wait for a long time.

Picture Book Time 73 Who's in the Loo?
Text by Jeanne Willis, Illustrations by Adrian Reynolds, Translation by Lin Yinghui
Publisher: Chiang Li Publishing Co., Ltd., 2007
Printed in Taiwan
WHO'S IN THE LOO?
Text copyright © Jeanne Willis, 2006
Illustrations copyright © Adrian Reynolds, 2006
Published by arrangement with Andersen Press Ltd.
Through Random Chinese Media Agency
All rights reserved.

[P3] Who's in the toilet?
The line outside is getting longer and longer!

[P4] Is it an elephant making the 'uh-huh, uh-huh' sound?
They usually take a long time to 'uh-huh'.
If it's not an elephant, who do you think it could be?

[P5] Is it a whale peeing? Peeing out the biggest puddle in the whole world!
Is it a tiger about to spray?
Or maybe a stray wombat doing a jump?
Could it be that a penguin's pee has turned into an 'ice pee pop'?

[P6] Could it be a rhinoceros making 'fragrant' 'hot curry'? 
Or maybe — a turtle! 
Isn't that right? They're never in a hurry! 
Whoever it is, this is really giving us a headache!

[P7] Maybe it's a hamster,
he can't reach the toilet seat.
Maybe it's a monkey,
he's washing his feet.
Or perhaps it's a snake,
he's sitting there leisurely eating candy.

[P8] Maybe it's a poor, slippery little whale,
who reached for the toilet paper, fell into the toilet,
and bounced around in the water like a black little ball.

[P9] Could it be a hippo's fat bottom
stuck in the toilet?

Could it be cheese making a mouse
sick to its stomach?

Or maybe a cat playing
with a little boat?

Who's in the bathroom?
Why are they taking so long?
We're all getting desperate, it's our turn now!

[P10] Could it be a crocodile trimming its claws?
Or perhaps a group of skunks washing their tails?
Maybe, the bathroom has been invaded by a batch of slow-moving snails?

[P11] Maybe it's a tree shrew who accidentally fell asleep?
Maybe it's a shepherd washing his sheep?
Or perhaps, a jaguar, feeling spontaneous, decided to change up his look? Everyone, come sneak a peek!

[P12] Could it be a weasel letting out a stink bomb?
Or maybe a pig washing its little underwear in the sink?

Or perhaps a little dolphin?
What do you think!?
Who is in the toilet after all?

[P13] Who is in the bathroom?
We can't guess at all.
Besides knocking hard on the door, it seems there's no other way!

We heard a tiny voice from inside. It said:
"It's me in the bathroom!
I'm just doing what my mom told me to do..."

"It takes a really long time!
You guys just won't understand!"

[P14] Turns out, it's a little octopus
washing his eight little hands!

[P15] Everyone is getting desperate to pee!
Why isn't the person in the bathroom coming out?
Who is in the bathroom?
Could it be penguin poop frozen into a 'pee popsicle'?
Or maybe a rhino making 'fragrant' 'hot curry'?
Perhaps a crocodile filing its nails?
Or a group of skunks washing their tails?...
In this book, you'll see all kinds of fun possibilities,
but until the very last page,
you'll never guess the truth!
Adults might quickly tire of this repetitive humor,
but children will be deeply captivated by certain images in the book, such as
a rhino having diarrhea, filling the whole bathroom with stink...
—School Library Journal

full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本封面，标题为《谁在厕所里？》，并标注了作者、绘者和译者信息，画面中可见蛇、老鼠等动物形象。
[P2] 本页为绘本《谁在厕所里？》的版权页，包含作者珍妮·威利斯、绘者阿德南·雷诺斯和译者林盈惠的简介，以及出版信息、ISBN、版权说明等内容。
[P3] 画面左侧显示人们排队等候进入厕所，右侧是两个孩子手牵手，表情期待，文字点出排队越来越长的场景。
[P4] 画面左右分页，左侧是大象的头部和前肢，它正用脚踩着卫生纸；右侧是大象的后半身，尾巴卷着卫生纸，正对着马桶。文字提出疑问，猜测是否是大象在上厕所。
[P5] 本页通过左右分页的插图和文字，连续提出几个幽默的猜测：左侧是鲸鱼在水中排尿，右侧依次是老虎、袋熊和企鹅，分别被想象成在喷尿、跳跃或结成冰棒，延续了前页对厕所里神秘动物的猜测。
[P6] 本页通过左右分页的插图，左侧展示犀牛喷出白色物质的场景，右侧是乌龟形象，文字继续猜测厕所里可能是犀牛在制造‘热咖哩’，也可能是不着急的乌龟，最后感叹这实在让人伤脑筋。
[P7] 本页通过左右分页的插图和文字，继续猜测厕所里可能是什么动物：左侧是仓鼠够不到马桶座，中间是猴子在洗脚，右侧是蛇悠闲地吃糖果，延续了前文幽默的猜测风格。
[P8] 本页通过左右分页的插图，左侧描绘一只小鲸鱼在水中挣扎，右侧文字猜测它可能是掉进马桶的可怜小鲸鱼，像黑色小皮球一样在水里跳来跳去，延续了前文对厕所里神秘动物的幽默想象。
[P9] 本页通过左右分页的插图和文字，继续猜测厕所里可能是什么动物：左侧是河马卡在马桶、老鼠吃坏肚子、猫咪玩小船的幽默想象；右侧是两个孩子焦急等待，抱怨上厕所的人太慢，表达他们急切想上厕所的心情。
[P10] 本页通过左右分页的插图和文字，继续猜测厕所里可能是什么动物：左侧是鳄鱼用剪刀修剪爪子，右侧是臭鼬在马桶上洗尾巴、蜗牛在下方爬行，文字幽默地提出可能是鳄鱼修指甲、臭鼬洗尾巴或蜗牛慢行，延续了前文对厕所里神秘动物的想象。
[P11] 本页通过左右分页的插图和文字，继续猜测厕所里可能是什么动物：左侧是牧羊人给羊洗澡，右侧是美洲豹在镜子前准备换造型，延续了前文对厕所里神秘动物的幽默想象。
[P12] 本页通过左右分页的插图和文字，继续猜测厕所里可能是什么动物：左侧是鼬鼠放臭屁、猪洗内裤的幽默想象；右侧是小海豚从马桶中跃出，文字以提问方式引导读者思考，延续了前文对厕所里神秘动物的幽默想象。
[P13] 本页描绘了孩子们焦急等待上厕所的场景，他们敲门并听到里面传来微弱的声音，解释自己正在做妈妈交代的事，而门外的孩子则抱怨时间太长，表达了对上厕所的急切心情。
[P14] 本页揭示厕所里神秘的动物原来是小章鱼，它正在水槽里洗八只小手，门外的两个孩子惊讶地发现真相。
[P15] 本页为绘本的封底，以幽默的文字回顾了书中对厕所里神秘动物的各种想象，并引用书评强调其对儿童的吸引力，同时包含出版信息和条形码。
